blocks.text: Particles ki tarteeb (arrangement) ki bunyad par solids do qisam ke hote hain:

items: Crystalline solids (jin ke particles ba-qaida tarteeb mein hon)
Amorphous solids (jin mein lambi ba-qaida tarteeb na ho)

blocks.alt: Do dabbe. Baen 'Crystalline': zarraat ba-qaida qataron aur kalamon mein, neeche 'ba-qaida tarteeb (long-range order)'. Daen 'Amorphous': zarraat be-tarteeb bikhre hue, neeche 'be-tarteeb (no long-range order)'.
blocks.caption: Crystalline aur amorphous solids mein zarraat ki tarteeb (hamara apna khaaka; kitab mein yeh figure nahi).
blocks.long_description: Crystalline solid apni tarteeb lambe faslon tak dohrata hai, jo makhsoos shaklein, sharp melting points, cleavage planes aur simt par munhasir khusoosiyat deta hai. Amorphous solid mein sirf chhote ba-tarteeb hisse hain, to woh had mein pighalta hai, us ki koi muqarrar heat of fusion nahi, use dhaala ja sakta hai aur woh har simt mein ek jaisa hai. Liquid crystal mein chhari-numa molecules behte hue taqreeban mutawazi rehte hain, to woh liquid ka behna aur viscosity crystal ki optical khusoosiyat aur anisotropy ke saath milata hai. Pighalna aur bukharat banna molar heats of fusion aur vaporization jazb karte hain.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Crystalline solid fauj ki parade jaisa hai: har particle apni muqarrar jagah par aur yeh tarteeb door tak dohrai jati hai. Amorphous solid bheer (crowd) jaisa hai: kahin kahin chhoti tarteeb, magar door tak koi pattern nahi. In dono ka muqabla Table 5.5 (topic 5.12.2) mein hai.

items: Particles ki tarteeb ki bunyad par solids do qisam ke: crystalline aur amorphous.
